description: For a relation \(R\subseteq A\times B\), every input has a unique related output if and only if there is a unique function \(f:A\to B\) with \(R(x,y)\leftrightarrow y=f(x)\) for all inputs and outputs.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderLogic.unique_function_iff.{u_1, u_2} {A : Type u_1} {B : Type u_2}
  (R : A → B → Prop) : (∀ (x : A), ∃! y, R x y) ↔ ∃! f, ∀ (x : A) (y : B), R x y ↔ y = f x
